catches: Only existing PureSky community solar customers can participate as referrers; the page states the program is 'Exclusive for our community solar customers'.
The referred friend must sign up through your custom referral link — the page stresses both parties only receive the cards if the link is used.
Community solar subscriptions are only available in the markets PureSky serves (e.g., Illinois); the referral has no value where PureSky has no solar farms.
Gift cards (not bill credits) are issued after the referral signs up; the page does not state an exact delivery timeline.

Savings framing: the $50 gift card is a one-time reward tied to enrolling in a community-solar subscription that itself reduces electricity bills; it is not cash income, and the referrer side requires already being a PureSky customer.
